clues.it: Dario era accanto a una colonna.
Luca era accanto a una pila di papiri e a un sarcofago.
clues.en: Luca was beside a stack of papyri and a sarcophagus.

clues.it: Anna era nella 6ª colonna, esattamente una riga a nord di Bruno e nella Sala delle Colonne.
clues.en: Anna was in the 6th column, exactly one row north of Bruno and in the Hall of Columns.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Fabio era esattamente una riga a nord di Carla.
clues.en: Fabio was exactly one row north of Carla.

clues.it: Irene era nella 2ª colonna e in una stanza diversa da Nino.
clues.en: Irene was in the 2nd column and in a different room from Nino.

general_clues.it: 1 seduta su un seggio di pietra.

steps.it: Solo Dario può stare nella 1ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 8ª è sua.
steps.en: Dario is the only one who can be in the 1st row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 8th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Luca lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Luca's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 5th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Anna più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 3ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Anna's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 3rd, column 6th.

steps.it: Solo Bruno può stare nella 4ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 3ª è sua.
steps.en: Bruno is the only one who can be in the 4th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 3rd is theirs.

steps.en: Nino is the only one who can be in the 6th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 4th is theirs.

steps.en: Fabio is the only one who can be in the 7th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 1st is theirs.

steps.en: Carla's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 8th, column 7th.

steps.en: Irene's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 9th, column 2nd.
